notes.title: ver1.4.4 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed a bug where the displayed baccarat cards did not always match their actual values.

notes.title: ver1.4.3 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]

- Improved input detection when guarding.
- Added an option in Game Config to turn off screen effects.

notes.title: ver1.4.2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed an issue where the guard timing would shift depending on the frame rate.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

- Improved some in-game text.

notes.title: Freedom Maker is now available starting today!
notes.notes:
Starting January 10, the deck-building puzzle RPG "Freedom Maker" is now available on Steam!

Enjoy a strategic RPG where you can create combos by matching puzzles of the same color or perfectly guard against enemy attacks for an exciting battle experience.

Gather puzzle pieces and build your ultimate deck!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3356540/Freedom_Maker/
